rule: A loading sequence names each stage and sets a progress percentage before doing the stage's work. Login is one click with no account step. The logged-in hook places the player on a fixed sector and tile. No onboarding is present: no tutorial, no welcome, no first task.
keep: named loading stages on a bar (a slow load reads as progress)
one quick entry path for demo or preview mode
a fixed first zone defined as data
change: login is a TODO: keep authentication on the server, never in the client
no onboarding present: use the ModernUO-shaped first-30-minute design instead
docs list number-key dialogue and on-screen XP as planned features; not in the code read
look_test: On the existing scene at 375 wide: loading screen with one spinner versus seven named stages on a bar; then click-to-enter with no name versus a two-second one-line card naming the first zone. Judge which reads as progress and which reads as a stub.
licence_note: RESTRICTED: no licence, derived from the RuneScape Classic client (_RESTRICTED-NOTE.txt line 1). Category-level inspiration only. No coordinates, constants, colour codes, copied text or code. Data read as names and tag counts only; nothing decompressed into output.
not_read: server half (not in tree; client connects to localhost)
tutorial, intro and welcome text (none present in code or XML data)
sound cue bodies (WAV, names only from AU013)
XML data bodies beyond tag counts
walk density, idle animation, death and respawn presentation, loot reveal, boss staging
